basis: Corticospinal neurodegeneration with peripheral axonal neuropathy in 5/7; motor findings reflect neurologic disease, not primary muscle damage.
Inherited cardiac electrical disorder with shortened QT and arrhythmias; no established extracardiac damage.
Transmissible prion disease causing cerebral and cerebellar degeneration; visual and motor manifestations generally arise from CNS damage.
Tertiary treponemal infection producing destructive gummas; sites vary, and no individual organ is established as affected in at least 30%.
Defined by chronic hypertension causing renal vascular and glomerular injury.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, sometimes with vestibular dysfunction; MYO7A alone does not establish retinal disease.
Apolipoprotein deficiency within hypoalphalipoproteinemia; no direct extra-metabolic organ damage established.
Autoinflammatory fibro-osseous jaw disease; missing or malformed teeth occur in 30-79%. Visual damage and airway obstruction are below 30%.
Diffuse astrocytic neoplasm originating in the CNS.
CRB1-associated congenital retinal dystrophy with severe visual impairment; no established extraocular disease.
Neonatal liver destruction with iron overload; most cases reflect gestational alloimmune liver disease. Extrahepatic siderosis alone does not establish functional damage.
Creatine biosynthesis disorder defined by neurodevelopmental impairment and myopathy; myopathy occurs in 30-79%. Low creatinine does not indicate renal damage.
Benign neoplasm arising in the cerebral hemispheres.
Neurodegeneration with defining optic atrophy, present in 4/4. Dysphagia and incontinence reflect neurologic dysfunction without established local organ damage.
Hepatitis E virus directly causes hepatic inflammation; fecal-oral transmission does not establish intestinal damage.
Fibro-osseous bone lesion, usually tibial, causing bowing and fractures; later neoplastic progression is a risk.
Compound hemoglobin S/Lepore sickling disorder of red cells; subtype-specific evidence does not establish additional direct organ damage in at least 30%.
Purine metabolic disorder with esophageal atresia in 2/2 and choanal obstruction in at least 1/2; rib, vertebral and limb malformations occur in about 50%.
Breast and ovarian cancer predisposition concerns organs outside the axes; risks of other cancers do not establish existing organ damage.
Autoimmune injury of cardiac muscle; the muscle-related parent does not establish skeletal muscle involvement.
Developmental, skeletal and cardiac defects define syndrome; renal/urinary malformations occur in 30-79%. Frequent ptosis omitted under the four-axis cap.
Isolated ventricular dilation and systolic dysfunction; stroke, hearing loss and myopathy are occasional and do not meet the involvement threshold.
Organic aciduria defined by optic atrophy and choreoathetosis; optic atrophy occurs in 10/10 and neurologic movement abnormalities in 80-99%.
Autoimmune adrenal destruction causes hormone deficiency; pigmentation, weakness, gastrointestinal symptoms and salt wasting do not establish direct extra-adrenal damage.
Adenocarcinoma arising in cervical or vaginal mesonephric remnants; reproductive sites have no axis, and the name does not imply renal origin.
